Alex R.: quick FYI 00:10UTC0 ran the TOC parity check for /kb vs the handbook index. found one page that isn't listed and one example with a broken codeblock render. can someone pick this up?

Nina: which page is missing from the index? i can add it if it's supposed to be public.

Alex R.: `/kb/observability/tracing.md` is not present in the handbook index.yaml. looks like frontmatter had `draft: true` by accident. codeblock render issue is in `/kb/samples/parallel-requests.md` where a fenced block uses triple backticks plus a stray leading tab and the site drops syntax highlighting.

Priya S.: i'll take the tracing frontmatter fix (should be one-line). will open a PR to toggle `draft: false` and add a short blurb to the changelog.

Alex R.: thanks. for the sample, would prefer a small cleanup PR to normalize fences rather than touching the build.

docs-bot: created issue #2205 for TOC/frontmatter parity and #2206 for codeblock rendering (https://go/repo/issues/2205, https://go/repo/issues/2206).

Nina: i'll do the sample codeblock PR in the morning. small sed + remove leading tab. tagging @priya in the PR for review.

Priya S.: quick note: if you change frontmatter, remember to run `scripts/generate-index` locally; i hit a weird cache once and the index didn't pick up new pages until i cleared `.cache/`.

Alex R.: good tip, thanks. plan: Priya will PR tracing fix, Nina will PR sample fence fix, i'll review both and merge if CI green. target EOD PT.

Nina: PR posted for codeblock: https://go/repo/pulls/2369 0 includes normalized fences + small clarifying comment in the sample.

Priya S.: PR posted for tracing frontmatter: https://go/repo/pulls/2370 0 toggles draft, adds index blurb, and updates changelog. left a tiny editorial suggestion.

Alex R.: reviewing now. both look small. once merged please add `docs:minor` label and ping team in the release notes channel.

Priya S.: merged 2370. CI passed.

Nina: merged 2369. site preview looks good now.

Alex R.: thanks all — closing the loop here. if anyone sees other TOC drift please drop on this thread or the docs-triage channel.
